EquationModule.run.doc:
Execute a named equation with the given parameters.

The returned dict has at minimum 'result' (the computed value), 'equation'
(the Equation object) and 'params' (the params used), and may include
additional diagnostic keys.

params.equation_name: name of an equation in this module's formulary
params.params: parameter values keyed by parameter name

EquationModule.viewer_data.doc:
Return data formatted for a specific viewer display mode.

The structure of the returned dict depends on the display mode.

params.equation_name: name of an equation in this module's formulary
params.params: parameter values keyed by parameter name

EquationModule.on_register.doc: Run when this module is registered. Override to hook registration.

params.registry: the registry the module was registered with

ModuleRegistry.register.doc: Register a module, index its equations, and call module.on_register().

params.module: the module to register; its name must be unique

raises.ValueError: a module of the same name is already registered

ModuleRegistry.get_module.doc: Return a registered module by name.
ModuleRegistry.get_module.returns: the module, or None if not registered

ModuleRegistry.get_equation.doc: Return a registered equation by its qualified name.
ModuleRegistry.get_equation.returns: the equation, or None if not registered

ModuleRegistry.list_equations.doc: List the registered equations by qualified name.

params.module_name: restrict to this module; None lists every module

params.params: parameter values keyed by parameter name

raises.KeyError: the module or equation is not registered
raises.ValueError: full_name is not of the form 'module.equation'

ModuleRegistry.summary.returns: a multi-line listing of every module and its equations

register.doc: Register a module with the global registry.

params.module: the module to register; its name must be unique
